moat_against: No demonstrated returns on capital: owner's earnings negative 0/5 of the last 5 years and roic_proxy negative in every recent year (-71.4% FY2023, -51.0% FY2024, -31.9% FY2025 in fundamentals.json)
Single-product concentration: 100% of revenue is Rezdiffra; pipeline beyond it (oral GLP-1 MGL-2086 Phase 1, siRNA and other licensed programs) is unapproved and early

Competition has arrived: Novo Nordisk's Wegovy was approved for the same F2-F3 MASH population in August 2025, Viking's VK2809 is a same-mechanism THR-beta rival, and FGF21 programs are now backed by Roche and Novo Nordisk
SBC is heavy and rising — $49.7M (FY2023) to $79.9M (FY2024) to $98.1M (FY2025) to $121.4M TTM — and the share count has compounded 9.4%/yr
Payer pressure is building: management guided gross-to-net into the high-30% range for 2026 as payer agreements took effect
moat_for: First FDA-approved MASH therapy (March 2024) for F2-F3 fibrosis — first-mover commercial infrastructure, physician familiarity and more than 49,000 patients on therapy at June 30, 2026

Patent estate extending resmetirom protection — a new U.S. patent issued August 2025 extends protection to February 2045, plus three new patents issued in Q2 2026 including a compensated-cirrhosis (F4c) patent
Specialty pricing power in the filed numbers: gross margin 96.5% in FY2024 (fundamentals.json) and Q2 2026 cost of sales of $40.0M on $364.3M of revenue in the company's release
Once-daily oral, liver-directed THR-beta mechanism with no titration — a differentiated profile versus injectable GLP-1s in a large, under-diagnosed market (management: ~460,000 diagnosed patients)
moat_justification: First-to-market Rezdiffra with a patent estate extending to 2045, specialty pricing power (FY2024 gross margin 96.5% in fundamentals.json) and 49,000+ patients on therapy, but no demonstrated return on capital: the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json is negative in every recent year (-71.4% FY2023, -51.0% FY2024, -31.9% FY2025), conservative owner's earnings are negative in 0 of the last 5 years, revenue is a single product, and Wegovy's August 2025 MASH approval plus same-mechanism and FGF21 rivals end the monopoly. A 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
name: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
one_liner: First-mover MASH franchise with real pricing power, moat 5/10 — but owner's earnings are negative on every basis (TTM base -$11.27/share; FY2025 -$12.84/share; 3-yr median -$20.09/share) and TTM free cash flow is negative even before SBC — Tier F on this screen; it does not clear 15% at any price on current numbers and no hurdle-clearing price is computed on a negative base. The ~$1.3B trailing-sales launch ramp is a re-rating story, not yet an owner's-earnings story.
